images.description: Illustration of a Scout standing with a bicycle at a trailhead, wearing a properly fitted helmet, backpack, and bright jersey, looking excited to start a ride with a trail stretching into the distance
A Scout riding a mountain bike on a forest singletrack trail with trees overhead creating dappled sunlight, wearing helmet and gloves, leaning into a gentle turn
Several types of bicycles lined up side by side on a clean surface: a road bike, mountain bike, gravel bike, BMX bike, and a commuter bike with fenders and a basket, showing the variety of cycling
A Scout on a bicycle scanning the road ahead while riding, hands positioned near the brake levers, wearing a bright yellow jersey and helmet, on a suburban street
Bird's-eye view illustration of a cyclist approaching an intersection, showing sight lines and potential hazard zones with turning cars, crosswalks, and proper lane positioning
An open compact first-aid kit sitting on a park bench next to a bicycle wheel, showing bandages, nitrile gloves, antiseptic wipes, moleskin, and gauze pads neatly organized
An illustrated field guide showing poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac leaves side by side with labels, set against a natural forest background
Diagram showing a cyclist riding in the correct lane position on a two-lane road, with arrows indicating traffic flow and a safe 4-foot gap from parked cars on the right
Clear illustration showing the three standard bicycle hand signals side by side: left turn (left arm straight out), right turn (right arm straight out), and stop (left arm down with palm back)
Close-up of a Scout demonstrating the 2-V-1 helmet fitting method, showing the helmet sitting two fingers above the eyebrow, straps forming a V below the ear, and chin strap snug
Flat-lay photograph of essential cycling gear arranged neatly on a wooden surface: helmet, padded gloves, water bottle, bike multi-tool, spare tube, mini pump, and a reflective vest
A Scout crouched next to a bicycle performing a pre-ride safety check, squeezing the front tire to check air pressure, with the bike on a kickstand in a driveway
Close-up of a Scout applying chain lubricant to a bicycle chain while slowly turning the pedals backward, with the bike mounted on a simple repair stand
Side view of a Scout demonstrating an emergency stop on a bicycle in a parking lot, weight shifted far back behind the saddle, both brake levers firmly engaged
A Scout riding a bicycle on a quiet residential street extending their left arm straight out to signal a left turn, wearing a helmet and bright clothing
A Scout cycling on a suburban street demonstrating proper lane position, riding past a row of parked cars with a safe 4-foot clearance, wearing helmet and reflective vest
Two Scouts riding road bikes side by side along a scenic rural road with rolling green hills and a clear blue sky, wearing helmets and bright jerseys
A Scout on a mountain bike demonstrating the ready (attack) position on a wide dirt trail, knees bent, elbows out, eyes looking forward, wearing helmet and protective gear
A Scout on a mountain bike crossing a section of trail with exposed tree roots, lifting the front wheel slightly, demonstrating proper body position with weight back
Two Scouts mountain biking together on a scenic trail through an open meadow with mountains visible in the background, both wearing helmets and smiling
